name: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Sage of Joseon
summary:
This DLC contains one Hunter, two Weapons, two Consumables, one Avatar, and one Frame:
- Roaming Sage (Hunter)
- Cold Patience (Uppercut)
- Yecheon’s Treasure (Hunting Bow)
- Tiger’s Fury (Dynamite Stick)
- Winged Purity (Waxed Dynamite Stick)
- Roaming Sage (Avatar)
- Roaming Sage (Frame)
